options.content:
The overview compares physical node capacity and Linux `MemAvailable` with running Pod container working sets and declared memory requests. `MemAvailable` is the kernel estimate of RAM available for new workloads; it is not calculated as capacity minus a Grafana working-set total.

The per-node accounting bars add to node capacity: selected largest Pods, **Other Pods** (all remaining running Pods, including namespaces outside the namespace filter), **Host / unattributed** (node used RAM minus all running Pod working sets), and **Available to Linux** (`MemAvailable`). The host remainder is signed and can be negative when cAdvisor and node memory accounting differ. It can include host processes, runtime memory, and collection/accounting gaps; it is not a pure OS bucket. Pod sizes come from kubelet working-set metrics, deduplicated by node, namespace, Pod, and container.

History selects the six largest namespace-filtered Pods by their maximum observed working set across the selected time range (one-minute subquery samples), then holds that membership constant across the graph. Host cache, buffers, slab, and kernel charts are separate overlapping views of node memory and must not be added to the Pod breakdown. The Pod table reports configured container limits only where a current limit series exists; its missing-limit count can mean either no configured limit or a missing kube-state-metrics sample.

panels.title: Node memory overview
panels.description: One row per node with current physical capacity, MemAvailable, running Pod working sets, declared running-Pod memory requests, MemoryPressure, node used RAM, and the signed host/unattributed remainder. Nodes without current node-exporter memory samples are not synthesized as zero.

Selected Pods are the six largest over the dashboard time range; Other Pods includes all remaining running Pods across every namespace. panels.title: Running Pod memory details
panels.description: One row per running Pod, scoped by node and namespace selectors. Working set, declared requests, and configured limits are sums across containers. A blank configured-limit cell means no current aggregate limit series; the adjacent count identifies containers without a current limit series, which may mean either an unset limit or a missing kube-state-metrics sample. Node RAM percentage uses physical node capacity. The outer join keeps Pods with missing requests or limits.

(label_join(sum by (node, namespace, pod) (max by (node, namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory",unit="byte",node=~"$node",namespace=~"$namespace"} and on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"} == 1))), "pod_key", "/", "node", "namespace", "pod")) and on (node) (max by (node) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"})))

(label_join(count by (node, namespace, pod) ((max by (node, namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{node=~"$node",pod!="",container!="",container!="POD",namespace=~"$namespace"} and on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"} == 1))) unless on (node, namespace, pod, container) (max by (node, namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory",unit="byte",node=~"$node",namespace=~"$namespace"} and on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"} == 1)) and on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"} == 1))), "pod_key", "/", "node", "namespace", "pod")) and on (node) (max by (node) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"})))

label_join(100 * (sum by (node, namespace, pod) (max by (node, namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{node=~"$node",pod!="",container!="",container!="POD",namespace=~"$namespace"} and on (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"} == 1)))) / on (node) group_left() (max by (node) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"}))), "pod_key", "/", "node", "namespace", "pod")

panels.title: Linux available RAM history
panels.description: node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes, the kernel estimate of memory available to new workloads. This is not calculated as node capacity minus a Grafana container working-set total.

targets.expr: max by (node) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: MemoryPressure state (0 = false, 1 = true)
panels.description: Kubernetes node MemoryPressure condition for nodes with current node-exporter memory samples. The false series is represented as zero only when kube-state-metrics reports the false condition; absent node or condition samples are not synthesized.

targets.expr: max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="MemoryPressure",status="true",node=~"$node"} and on (node) (max by (node) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"})))) or on (node) (0 * max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="MemoryPressure",status="false",node=~"$node"} and on (node) (max by (node) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"})))))
